tools.name: cats
tools.why: run executes the CATS fuzzer directly; init's doctor check verifies it's on PATH

tools.name: uv
tools.why: init, run, report, analyze, and fp all invoke cats_tool.py via `uv run` -- no fallback is documented

config.why: run, report, analyze, and fp all read it for spec/server/results-dir/identities; run points the user at /cats:init when it's missing
